meaning:
ἐνδημέω, -ῶ
(ἔνδημος, living in a place),
to live in a place, be at home: ἐν τ. σώματι, 2Co.5:6 5:9; πρὸς τ. Kύριον, 2Co.5:8.†
(AS)

renderings.bsb: we are at home in this body

elsewhere.note: Therefore we are always confident and know that while we are at home in the body, we are absent from the Lord;
